journey.name: Subscriptions Payments Tab
journey.description: The Payments tab inside Subscriptions: the pending badge on the tab, an incoming request with its Dismiss and Pay actions, an outgoing request showing pending in place of the fiat amount, and the payment request detail screen. Requires one incoming and one outgoing Paykit Payment Request.

actions.action: Launch the E2E Bitkit app with Paykit UI enabled, one incoming Payment Request pending, and one outgoing Payment Request awaiting the recipient
Open the drawer menu and tap Subscriptions

Verify the Payments tab (testTag "Tab-payments") shows a badge with the pending incoming count, rendered immediately after the label with a 6.dp gap, the label still centred in the tab, and its indicator level with the other tabs
Verify the payment requests list (testTag "PaymentRequestsScreen") appears under the PAYMENT REQUESTS header
Verify the incoming request card shows Dismiss and Pay actions
Verify the outgoing request row shows "pending" where the fiat amount sits
Verify the details screen (testTag "PaymentRequestDetailsScreen") shows DATE, TIME, CONTACT, TAGS and NOTE sections
Verify the contact card is sized to its content rather than the full width, and that a divider follows the contact and tags sections
Verify the note card is drawn with the torn paper top edge
Press Android back and verify the list is shown again
Verify Request Payment (testTag "PaymentRequestCreate") is visible at the bottom and that list rows scroll underneath it
